title: Repository Hosting Platform — GitHub
description: Largest Git host with pull requests and Actions.
body:
1. Tool identity. This record is the public-edition reference for GitHub, a repository hosting platform. Largest Git host with pull requests and Actions. Category: Version Control and Collaboration.

2. Actual implementation. A working implementation ships inside this record as executable JavaScript (demo.program) and was executed in Node.js; the verified output is stored in demo.output. The demonstration exercises the tool's core behavior: [GitHub] repo acme/web: 128 stars, 34 forks, default branch main, CI passing.

3. Inputs and outputs. This class of tool takes file changes and contributor actions and produces commit history, merge results, and issue states. The demonstration's input is a scenario selector (0-7); its output is the human-readable result line kept in demo.output.

5. Tests and examples. This record's demonstration scenario was executed in Node.js and its real output captured in demo.output. Re-running demoMain with the same scenario index reproduces it byte-for-byte.
